title: To You, in 2000 Years
synopsis: A hundred years of peace end the day the Colossal Titan appears above Wall Maria.

title: That Day
synopsis: The fall of Shiganshina: Eren loses his mother, his home and his innocence in a single afternoon.

title: A Dim Light Amid Despair
synopsis: Eren awakens in the refugee camp and learns what the walls really cost.

title: The Night of the Closing Ceremony
synopsis: Training begins. Ten years of peace shatter into a single night of resolve.

title: First Battle
synopsis: Trost is breached and the 104th Cadet Corps faces a titan for the first time.

title: The World the Girl Saw
synopsis: Mikasa’s past is revealed as the cadets fight to survive the streets of Trost.

title: Small Blade
synopsis: Armin’s plan buys a blade’s length of hope against an impossible enemy.

title: I Can Hear His Heartbeat
titleJP: 心臓の鼓動が聞こえる
synopsis: Eren is swallowed — and something inside the titan begins to move.

title: Whereabouts of His Left Arm
synopsis: A titan fights titans, and the garrison watches a boy step out of its spine.

title: Response
synopsis: Eren’s transformation is covered up, and the plan to retake Trost begins.

title: Idol
synopsis: The boulder must reach the gate. Pixis gambles the lives of everyone behind him.

title: Wound
synopsis: Eren’s body fails at the worst moment, and Mikasa steps into the gap.

title: Primal Desire
synopsis: The gate is sealed. Humanity wins its first battle — and learns what Eren is worth.

title: Can’t Look Into His Eyes Yet
synopsis: A tribunal decides whether Eren is a weapon, a monster, or a soldier.

title: Special Operations Squad
synopsis: Levi takes custody of Eren. The Squad prepares for what comes next.

title: What Needs to Be Done Now
synopsis: The 57th expedition departs with a lie on its back and a target on its heels.

title: Female Titan
synopsis: An intelligent titan tears through the formation hunting Eren.

title: Forest of Giant Trees
synopsis: The trap is set in the canopy — and the Female Titan walks straight into it.

title: Bite
synopsis: Levi’s squad dies defending a boy who cannot transform.

title: Erwin Smith
synopsis: The Commander’s gambit is revealed, and the Female Titan escapes.

title: Crushing Blow
synopsis: The Stohess operation begins; Annie Leonhart stops running.

title: The Defeated
synopsis: The Female Titan is unmasked inside Wall Sina, and crystallises before capture.

title: Smile
synopsis: Aftermath: the dead are counted, the living are questioned, and Wall Rose is breached again.

title: Mercy
synopsis: The supply squad turns on itself; Connie’s village is found silent.

title: Wall
synopsis: A titan appears inside Wall Rose, and the season ends with a hand on a wall.

title: Beast Titan
synopsis: The Beast Titan speaks. A wall is breached from the inside out.

title: I’m Home
synopsis: Sasha returns to her village and finds that hospitality has a price.

title: Southwestward
synopsis: The scouts ride for Wall Rose, chasing a breach that may not exist.

title: Soldier
synopsis: Utgard Castle falls, and a warrior learns what he is willing to do.

title: Historia
synopsis: A name is chosen: Historia Reiss means to live up to it.

title: Warrior
synopsis: Reiner and Bertholdt reveal themselves on the wall above Utgard.

title: Close Combat
synopsis: Eren fights the Armored Titan hand to hand and loses the will to win.

title: The Hunters
synopsis: The scouts pursue the traitors into the forest of giant trees.

title: Opening
synopsis: Hannes stands his ground. The Coordinate awakens.

title: Children
synopsis: Reiner remembers the mission as Bertholdt prepares to burn the forest down.

title: Charge
synopsis: The Survey Corps’ suicidal charge gives Erwin a moment to speak truth.

title: Scream
synopsis: Eren commands titans to his side, and a mother is saved too late.

title: Smoke Signal
synopsis: The Survey Corps is hunted by the crown as a new enemy appears in the Interior.

title: Pain
synopsis: Levi’s squad fights the interior police in a wood outside Stohess.

title: Old Story
synopsis: Kenny Ackerman’s past is told, and Levi’s beginning with it.

title: Trust
synopsis: The plan to abduct Historia begins with a fake murder and a silenced crowd.

title: Reply
synopsis: Historia is offered a throne. She answers with her own will.

title: Sin
synopsis: Rod Reiss reveals the truth of the walls’ founding and his own crime.

title: Wish
synopsis: Historia takes her father’s syringe and decides what kind of queen she will be.

title: Outside the Walls of Orvud
synopsis: A 120-metre titan crawls toward the district. The cadets hold the wall.

title: Ruler of the Walls
synopsis: Historia shatters her father’s titan, and the Reiss chapel collapses.

title: Friends
synopsis: Eren’s father’s journal becomes the only path forward.

title: Bystander
synopsis: The Survey Corps returns to Shiganshina with a plan, a press corps and a debt.

title: Night of the Battle to Retake the Wall
synopsis: The night before departure, every soldier makes their peace.

title: The Town Where Everything Began
synopsis: The retaking of Shiganshina begins in perfect, terrible silence.

title: Thunder Spears
synopsis: The Armored Titan is brought to its knees by a weapon built for it.

title: Descent
synopsis: The Beast Titan enters the field, and the formation is annihilated.

title: Perfect Game
synopsis: Zeke pitches. Erwin’s gamble costs the lives of his soldiers.

title: Hero
synopsis: Armin holds the Colossal Titan long enough for the impossible.

title: Midnight Sun
synopsis: One syringe, two bodies, and a choice that defines the Survey Corps.

title: The Basement
synopsis: The door opens. Grisha’s journal rewrites everything the scouts know.

title: That Day
synopsis: Grisha’s memories: Marley, the restorationists and the Attack Titan’s burden.

title: Attack Titan
synopsis: The Attack Titan has always moved forward, across memory and time.

title: The Other Side of the Wall
synopsis: The sea. For the first time, the horizon is not a wall — and Eren asks the question.

title: The Other Side of the Sea
synopsis: Four years later, a boy in Liberio runs through a war he does not understand.

title: Midnight Train
synopsis: Marley’s war ends, and the warriors come home to a country that uses them.

title: The Door of Hope
synopsis: Falco meets a wounded soldier in a hospital and changes a history.

title: From One Hand to Another
synopsis: Letters, memories and a festival invitation arrive in Liberio.

title: Declaration of War
synopsis: Willy Tybur declares war on Paradis. Eren answers from the audience.

title: The War Hammer Titan
synopsis: A new titan enters the fight beneath the stage, and the survey corps descends.

title: Assault
synopsis: The raid on Liberio becomes a massacre on both sides of the fence.

title: Assassin's Bullet
synopsis: Sasha Blouse dies on an airship, and a boy hears a name he will never forget.

title: Brave Volunteers
synopsis: Paradis learns to build a navy and to mistrust the people building it.

title: A Sound Argument
synopsis: Hizuru’s offer, Kiyomi’s eyes and the cold mathematics of survival.

title: Deceiver
synopsis: A coup inside the walls, and a wine cellar nobody counted.

title: Guides
synopsis: Nicolo serves a meal that becomes an apology and a reckoning.

title: Children of the Forest
synopsis: Sasha’s family meets the girl who shot her, and chooses.

title: Savagery
synopsis: The Jaegerist uprising spills across the island in a single night.

title: Sole Salvation
synopsis: Zeke and Ksaver: the making of a man who would end his own people.

title: Above and Below
synopsis: The survey corps splits between those who follow Eren and those who stop him.

title: Judgement
synopsis: The Marleyan fleet arrives at Shiganshina, and the Nine collide.

title: Sneak Attack
synopsis: A coordinated ambush turns the port into a graveyard of airships.

title: Two Brothers
synopsis: Eren and Zeke meet inside the Paths, and the world goes quiet.

title: Memories of the Future
synopsis: The Founding Titan shows Eren a future he has already chosen.

title: From You, 2000 Years Ago
synopsis: Ymir’s choice, and the origin of all titans, is finally spoken.

title: Thaw
synopsis: The Rumbling begins. Annie returns to a world she no longer recognises.

title: Sunset
synopsis: Two fronts, one sunset; old enemies share a campfire because there is nothing else left.

title: Pride
synopsis: A port is taken, a titan falls, and the alliance loses someone irreplaceable.

title: Night of the End
synopsis: Confessions around a fire: what each of them is guilty of, and why they fight anyway.

title: Traitor
synopsis: The alliance reaches Fort Salta and finds the founder waiting.

title: Retrospective
synopsis: In the Paths, Armin reminds Zeke what small things are worth living for.

title: The Dawn
synopsis: The Rumbling stops. The world remains, changed beyond recognition — and so do they.
